title: Error
description: The base shape of every non-zero exit under --json (DESIGN.md §3). A move the diagram doesn't draw adds allowed. A gate refusal (slice 6) adds id, result, gates and failures.

error.description: One line saying what went wrong and how to fix it.

exit_code.description: The same as the process's exit code: 1 bad input, 2 refused by a gate, 3 the store, a file or git can't be read.

allowed.description: Only when a move was refused because the state diagram (DESIGN.md §2.2) doesn't draw it: every move allowed from the item's state, in the diagram's order. Empty for an item in review.

via.description: The command that makes the move.

to.description: The state the move leads to.

command.description: How to run it on this item, with … where a reason goes.
